name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The _58 suffix is the per-event dispatch-table index (slot @ 0x51CF1; index = (0x51CF1 - table_base 0x51B91)/4 = 0x58), a meaningful domain ID, NOT an address residue (0x58 != self addr 0x360f1 and is not a data address). __unref_sentinel correctly describes the role: an unreferenced no-op placeholder dispatch slot. Consistent with the sibling sentinel handlers 55/56/57/59 in the same file.
purpose: Per-event dispatch-table slot 0x58 (table @ 0x51B91): an unreferenced no-op sentinel placeholder that does nothing. Confirmed unreferenced by all 4 consequence-dispatch paths (turn-event, tile-step latch, tile_pickup, kill-drop) + direct callers -- vestigial 90-entry-table padding.
logic_summary: 7-byte stub: PUSH 4; JMP 0x360DD, which falls into the shared 'CALL __CHK; RET' tail hosted in fd2_chapter_event_handler_55 @ 0x360D8. Net effect is a Watcom __CHK stack-probe (frame size 4) followed by an immediate return -- no state mutation, no display, no dialog. The arg is not read. The only xref is the dispatch-table data pointer at 0x51CF1; no chapter FDFIELD turn-event / tile-step hook references this slot (unref / possibly cut content). The borrowed __CHK;RET tail is a binary size optimisation; the functionally-exact source is an empty body (matches siblings 55/56/57/59).

notes: No source change (comment already precise/accurate/ASCII and consistent with sibling sentinels 55/56/57/59). Name and param kept. Ghidra plate is consistent with the refined understanding (same stub, same borrowed tail, same unref/sentinel conclusion), so plate left unchanged. Verified table index: xref to 0x360f1 is the data slot @ 0x51CF1; (0x51CF1-0x51B91)/4 = 0x58. Disassembly confirms PUSH 0x4; JMP 0x000360DD; 0x360DD = CALL 0x36CD7 (__CHK); RET.
